subject.title: fix(auto-reply): hide recovered failed tool progress

question: Should regular verbose mode treat recovered failed tool progress as internal diagnostic state by default, showing it only when there is no confirmed visible non-error delivery while preserving full-verbose diagnostics?
rationale: The patch is not merely a mechanical leak fix: it changes the default user-facing policy for how much transient failure information ordinary verbose users receive across channels.

options.title: Adopt buffered regular-verbose delivery
options.body: Keep the proposed default: hide recovered failures only after confirmed clean delivery, retain full-verbose diagnostics, and preserve terminal or undelivered failure visibility.

options.title: Keep immediate progress visibility
options.body: Retain the existing regular-verbose behavior and pursue any alternate suppression policy only through a separately sponsored product design.

recommendation.title: Adopt buffered regular-verbose delivery
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed default: hide recovered failures only after confirmed clean delivery, retain full-verbose diagnostics, and preserve terminal or undelivered failure visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the deepest documented implementation context in the available review history; a repository reply-delivery owner should make the final policy call.
